description: Upload the local taste profile (from muggle-local-taste-profile-set) so Muggle Test runs use it as guidance. Screens every statement, context and evidence excerpt first, redacting API keys, tokens, JWTs, private keys, emails and password-like key=value pairs; the raw signal journal is never sent, only the short excerpts the profile cites as evidence. Honors the tasteProfileUpload preference: 'never' refuses, 'ask' returns outcome 'needs-consent' with the screened profile until called with hasUserApprovedThisUpload: true, 'always' uploads. Replaces each uploaded section remotely and keeps the rest; records each section's upload state and re-renders the readable ~/.muggle-ai/taste/profile.md. Returns { outcome, message, redactionCount, hasUploadedUserSection, uploadedProjectIds, remoteProfile }.

hasUserApprovedThisUpload.description: True only after the user approved this upload in the tasteProfileUpload picker. Needed when the preference is 'ask'; ignored under 'always'; never overrides 'never'.

name: muggle-remote-taste-profile-upload
